string.text: Special muzzle device that decreases felt recoil.

Manufactured using a unique technology, barrel has a special rifling and creates increased chamber pressure, when a cartridge is fired. Due to this the bullet tumbles and enters a body at a random angle. When it hits the target, the bullet causes truly horrifying damage to the tissue, which is usually fatal. Destabilization of the bullet decreases accuracy, and higher pressure results in increased recoil.

Due to high impact energy and vibration when a cartridge is fired, standard magazine catch becomes loose and cannot properly lock the magazine inside the grip. Increased play of the magazine may cause malfunctions. Improved catch is designed to fix the issue.
Stabilizes bullet trajectory, which improves accuracy.
Slightly reduces overall weight. Every little thing helps, considering the weight of the firearm.
Counterweights installed in the frame of the gun to fit the shooter's preferences. Reduces recoil, thus positively affecting accuracy.
Individual adjustment and balancing of the standard parts of the trigger mechanism improves accuracy while simultaneously lowering recoil.
Rail mount enables installation of additional tactical accessories.
Combines the functions of narrow beam tactical flashlight and laser sight. Particularly useful in night conditions.
Tritium-illuminated sights increase speed and comfort of aiming in poorly-lit environments.
Improves obturation and accuracy by removing play in the chamber.
Application of a protective coating to the internal parts significantly reduces wear.
Reconfiguration of the trigger assembly with improvement of various parts gives a crisp break with a shorter, smoother trigger take-up, leading to faster follow-up shots.
Decreases felt recoil, making the shooting more comfortable and accurate.
Improves obturation and muzzle velocity thanks to tighter lock-up.
Application of a protective coating to the parts significantly reduces wear.
Modifications to the gas operating system help to reduce felt recoil
Significantly reduces weight by replacing standard steel parts with maintenance polymer ones.
Rubberized grip panels made to fit the shooter's preferences. New panels allow for better grip and more comfortable shooting.
Stronger titanium replacement parts of the trigger assembly improves durability.
